Are you a hands-on leader who enjoys building relationships, improving systems, leading people and driving business growth?    WA's fastest-growing battery recycling businesses, providing safe, compliant and environmentally responsible battery collection solutions to businesses across Perth, the Southwest and some of WA's leading mining companies, is looking for their Ops & Growth Manager.    Following the establishment of thier facility in 2025, they've experienced more than 30% annual growth and are now seeking an Operations & Growth Manager to help drive the next stage of our journey.    This is a unique opportunity to join a growing business where your ideas, leadership and initiative will directly influence future success.   
 What's on Offer? 
 ? $120,000 + Super    ? Fully maintained Amarok Ute    ? Monday-Friday | 8am-4pm    ? Flexible working arrangements    ? Leadership role with genuine autonomy    ? Growing business operating in a booming industry    ? Opportunity to build and lead your own team    ? Be part of the circular economy and environmental sustainability sector   
 About the Role 
 Reporting directly to the Owner, this newly created leadership position combines operations management, team leadership and business development.    You'll play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while helping expand customer base across Perth and Southwest WA.    Your responsibilities will include:   
 
 Leading and supporting a team of operational staff   
 Managing customer relationships and ensuring service excellence   
 Coordinating logistics, scheduling and battery collection operations   
 Developing and implementing operational systems and procedures   
 Supporting WHS, compliance and quality initiatives   
 Monitoring fleet movements and operational performance   
 Preparing quotations, proposals and customer solutions   
 Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities   
 Supporting marketing initiatives and industry events   
 Working closely with the Owner to drive continued growth   
 
 About You 
 You may currently be working as an:   
 
 Operations Manager   
 Service Manager   
 Branch Manager   
 Logistics Manager   
 Waste Management Supervisor   
 Depot Manager   
 Business Development Manager   
 Operations Supervisor   
 
 To succeed, you'll bring:   
 
 Previous leadership or people management experience   
 Strong organisational and planning skills   
 Excellent communication and customer relationship abilities   
 Commercial awareness and business development capability   
 Strong administrative and computer skills   
 Experience within logistics, transport, waste management, industrial services or similar industries   
 Permanent Australian working rights   
 
 Most importantly, you'll be proactive, solutions-focused and excited by the opportunity to grow with a business that is making a real difference.    This isn't a corporate environment where decisions take months and good ideas get lost in red tape.    You'll work directly alongside the owner, have a genuine say in how the business operates, and help shape the future of a company operating in one of Australia's fastest-growing environmental sectors.    If you're looking for a role that offers variety, responsibility, leadership and long-term growth, we'd love to hear from you.     Additional Requirements    
 
 Proof of right to work in Australia   
 Pre-employment medical, including drug & alcohol screening   
 Pre-employment police check   
 
   How to Apply  Click the  "Apply Now"  button or email your resume directly to:  Katy.Fitzpatrick@Programmed.com.au        

  Who we are  
 As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to. 
 At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. 
 We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply. 
   So it's over to you, if this opportunity is right for you apply today!    
  To learn more about Programmed, we encourage you to visit our website.   Please  click here  to apply.

Company: GT Haulage Pty Ltd
Position: Truck Driver (Multiple)
Address: 29 Kendall ave crestwood 2620, NSW
Salary: 80,000 + super

Company Details:
GT Haulage Pty Ltd is a well-established transport and logistics company dedicated to providing reliable and efficient freight services across Australia. Due to business growth, we are currently seeking experienced Truck Drivers to join our professional team.

Minimum Requirements:
Valid Heavy Rigid (HR) or Heavy Combination (HC) Truck Licence – required.
Minimum 1 year of relevant driving experience in a similar role.
Knowledge of Chain of Responsibility (CoR) and Fatigue Management principles.
Basic mechanical knowledge to perform daily vehicle checks.

Key Responsibilities:
Operate heavy vehicles in accordance with road and safety regulations.
Load, secure, transport, and unload goods safely and efficiently.
Conduct pre-start inspections and report any maintenance or safety issues.
Maintain accurate delivery records, logbooks, and paperwork.
Communicate effectively with dispatch, warehouse, and clients.
Adhere to fatigue management and Chain of Responsibility (CoR) requirements.
Ensure timely delivery schedules while maintaining safety as a top priority.

Skills & Attributes Required:
Strong understanding of road safety rules and transport regulations.
Excellent driving and navigation skills.
Good communication and time management abilities.
Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently.
Physically fit to perform loading and unloading tasks if required.
A commitment to workplace health, safety, and compliance.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

THE REALISE GROUP | FLEXIBLE, PAID ASSIGNMENTS

Looking for flexible work you can fit around your lifestyle?
 
The Realise Group is seeking reliable, detail-oriented individuals to join our national network of Mystery Shoppers. Complete visits undercover as a regular customer, then fill in a survey providing structured, factual feedback about your experience. Your feedback enables organisations to improve service standards, team performance, and overall customer satisfaction.
 
WHAT A MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES:
 
Visit retail stores, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, shopping centres and a variety of other businesses
Visits may be in-store, or occasionally may involve phone or website enquiries
Observe service, selling skills, promotions, presentation and cleanliness standards
Submit clear online reports after each assignment
 
Full instructions are provided for every job.
 
WHAT MAKES A GOOD MYSTERY SHOPPER:
 
Paying attention to detail                                                                                                   
Able to follow detailed instructions 
Clear written communication 
Comfortable using a smartphone and computer 
Reliable and able to meet deadlines
 
No previous experience required.
 
GET PAID PER ASSIGNMENT:
 
Payment is typically $15–$50+ per assignment plus
Reimbursement for required purchases (in addition to your payment)
Payment made via direct debit to your bank account (no points, credits, vouchers or PayPal payments, just real cash!)
 
JOIN OUR TEAM:
If you enjoy independent work and want flexible, paid assignments, apply today to join The Realise Group’s Mystery Shopper network.
 
APPLY HERE and read more info: https://therealisegroup.com.au/become-a-mystery-shopper

Looking for flexible work you can fit around your lifestyle?

Visit retail stores, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, shopping centres and a variety of other businesses

Submit clear online reports after each assignment
 
Full instructions are provided for every job.

Paying attention to detail                                                                                                   
Able to follow detailed instructions 
Clear written communication 
Comfortable using a smartphone and computer 
Reliable and able to meet deadlines
 
No previous experience required.
 
GET PAID PER ASSIGNMENT:

result.description:
Kulparri – Tyres & Mechanical

Located in Newman, Kulparri – Tyres & Mechanical provides high-quality tyre, mechanical, auto electrical and air-conditioning services for all vehicle types. With access to leading tyre brands and a wide range of size0s, we’re proud to deliver reliable service to our local community.

Due to continued growth, we’re looking for experienced and motivated Automotive Mechanics to join our team on a full-time basis.

You will be responsible for delivering safe, efficient and high-quality mechanical services, including:

* Performing scheduled servicing and maintenance (oil changes, brake inspections, etc.)
* Diagnosing and troubleshooting mechanical and electrical faults using modern diagnostic tools
* Repairing and replacing mechanical and electrical components
* Conducting vehicle testing to ensure safety, reliability and quality standards are met
* Accurately documenting all work performed and maintaining service records
* Supporting day-to-day workshop operations to meet business objectives
* Ensuring the workshop is kept clean, tidy and well organized

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* Australian trade qualifications (Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent) – highly regarded
* Proven experience as an Automotive Mechanic / Technician
* Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency with automotive diagnostic equipment and tools
* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers and team members
* A strong work ethic and commitment to safety
* A genuine passion for the automotive industry and continuous learning

Ready to join the team? Appy now!
result.title: Automotive Mechanics

result.description:
Job Description - Motor Mechanic
Our client in the area of Goulburn Valley in Victoria is looking for a hardworking and enthusiastic candidate to fill the position of "Motor Mechanic". Our client is well known repetitive business which provides exceptional services for vehicle maintenance and vehicle services.

As a suitable candidate you must be able to perform the below mentioned tasks:
- detecting and diagnosing faults in engines and parts
- dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts
- repairing and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed
- performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles  
   and ensure compliance with pollution regulations
- reassembling engines and parts after being repaired
- testing and adjusting mechanical parts after being repaired for proper performance
- diagnosing and testing parts with the assistance of computers
- may inspect vehicles and issue roadworthiness certificates or detail work required to achieve roadworthiness

Experience and Qualifications: -
- Have minimum qualification of Certificate/Diploma level of qualifications in Automotive Technology.
- Having experience in exceptional customer service and rapport.
- Have a minimum of 3 years full-time of experience as a Motor Mechanic.
- Must have can-do attitude and attention to detail.

Are you Interested?

Great salary range in between $75,000 to $83,000 plus superannuation per annum. Location of the Job: Tatura, Goulburn Valley, Victoria
Just use the Apply now button and we will be in touch with the shortlisted applicants only.

result.description:
Parkview Hotel and Jak Hospitality are seeking expression of interest from qualified and experienced Cooks (multiple) for Parkview Hotel (Orange), Millthorpe Hotel (Central West), Parrot Distilling Co (Orange) locations.


You must possess either a min of Certificate IV in Cookery or have a minimum of 3 years of work experience as a Cook. Salary range offered is $80,000 to $82,000 plus superannuation dependent on your skills, experience, and uniqueness you will bring to the business.  An ideal candidate should be professionally qualified and/or experienced in a busy environment and can work under pressure.  These positions are open to Australian professionals as well as overseas professionals.


Reporting to the Chef, key duties for this position are as follows: 

•	Food preparation and dish creations as per the menu
•	Prepare diet specific food items and customised orders
•	Ensure food presentation and plating meets quality benchmarks
•	Estimate of food and labour costs within the kitchen operations
•	Actively take part in deciding weekly specials and their market prices
•	Assist the Chef to recruit staff, including junior cooks and other kitchen workers.
•	Supervise and coordinate activities of junior workers engaged in food preparation.
•	Check the quantity and quality of received products and inventory
•	Monitor sanitation and hygiene practices, and food regulations of the kitchen workers
•	Receive and implement customer feedback and suggestions where required
•	Assist management in budgeting, negotiating prices and kitchen purchases
•	Contribute to planning of special events e.g. weddings, parties, and banquets.

The team at Flexiforce are seeking an experienced and motivated Daytime Team Leader for a well-established Manufacturing & Distribution Company based in Revesby, NSW.
This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful applicant will play a key role in supervising the essential day-to-day running of the business within the warehouse, incl. Pick/Pack and Forklift Operations, as well as ERP/WMS systems use.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their warehousing career with a respected and growing company.


Work Hours:
•	6:00am – 2:00pm or 8:00am – 4:00pm
•	Location: Revesby NSW

Main Duties Include:
•	Leading and supervising a small warehouse team
•	Overseeing daily pick, pack and dispatch operations
•	Allocating work and monitoring workflow to meet daily deadlines
•	Operating ERP/WMS systems for stock movements, reporting and order processing
•	Conducting quality checks and maintaining high safety standards
•	Operating forklifts, including loading/unloading and stock replenishment
•	Training and supporting new team members
•	Completing daily reporting and liaising with Warehouse Management


Main Criteria:

•	Previous experience in warehouse pick/pack and dispatch operations
•	Demonstrated team leadership or supervisory experience
•	Experience using ERP or Warehouse Management Systems (SAP, Oracle or similar)
•	Current LF Forklift Licence (High Reach experience highly regarded)
•	Strong organisational and time management skills
•	Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
•	Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards
•	Ability to lead by example in a fast-paced environment

Reliability is a MUST!

If this sounds like you and you would like to apply, please get in touch ASAP.
Email your resume to: enquiries@flexiforce.com.au
